angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,320,541 km at 94.52 pc = 0.19 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.5796 +/- 0.0279 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 94.52 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.898 (1.860 to 1.937) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,320,541 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.166 (1.126 to 1.206) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5815 +/- 4.6 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2340155679036275200: teff_gspphot 5814.85 K (16th-84th percentiles 5811.56-5820.7236), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2340155679036275200: teff_gspphot 5814.85 K (16th-84th percentiles 5811.56-5820.7236), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/axolotl.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.948, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 224693 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 V, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 224693 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.27 dex, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 224693 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.61, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 224693 (pscomppars): age 4.12 Gyr, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 224693 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.5 km/s, from Johnson et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...647..600J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
